name: archboard-text
responsibility: Shapes a run of words into glyphs in the bundled faces and breaks a paragraph to a width
description: The archboard-text crate (ADR 0059). Every width that a layout reads and every glyph that a painter draws comes from here, so every place draws a picture to the same numbers and no picture needs a font loaded. A character that Onest or Maple Mono NL lacks comes from the Noto fallback faces, in the one order of Face::fallbacks, for measuring, breaking and drawing alike. Skrifa gives each glyph its outline.
